name: ALDI
subtitle: Quality Products at Affordable Prices
description: ALDI is a leading grocery retailer offering quality products at everyday low prices. Discover a wide selection of fresh produce, fresh meat and seafood, dairy, frozen foods, bakery items, deli meats, snacks, pantry essentials, beverages, wine, beer, household items, baby products, pet supplies, and personal care items. Shop ALDI Finds for limited-time special products, view weekly specials and ads, and find recipes to inspire your meals.
